description: This file contains the implementation of classes related to grain reference creation and management within the Orleans distributed framework. It includes classes for activating grain references, providing proxies, and managing reference lifetime.

classes.name: GrainReferenceActivator
classes.description: Central class responsible for creating and managing grain references. It maintains a cache of activators keyed by grain type and interface type.

classes.name: UntypedGrainReferenceActivatorProvider
classes.description: Provides grain reference activators for grains without specific interface types, creating untyped grain references.

classes.name: RpcProvider
classes.description: Maps GrainInterfaceType to generated proxy types, enabling creation of strongly-typed grain references.

classes.name: GrainReferenceActivatorProvider
classes.description: Creates grain references that use dynamically generated proxy objects based on grain interfaces, supporting options like unordered invocation.

methods.name: CreateReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a given grain id and interface type.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an activator or proxy type based on grain and interface types.

methods.name: CreateActivator
methods.description: Creates and caches a new grain reference activator for a given grain type and interface type.

methods.name: GetMainInterface
methods.description: Helper to determine the primary interface type for proxy type registration.
